summary: Tested inventory-value display + per-item sell/withdraw feature. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass for /api/skins/sell and /api/skins/withdraw (single, all, unauth, invalid payload, double-sell, persistence via /auth/me and /profile). Frontend: guest chip absent, main-page inventory-value-chip shows 'Инвентарь · 3' / '137,00', profile-inventory-value + inventory-total-label + sell-all-button all show 137,00, sell-mode-switch removed (count=0). Item overlay works: hidden (opacity 0, pointer-events none) until card click, only one active card at a time, re-click hides, inactive overlay buttons are not clickable. Single sell => toast 'Продано 1 предм. — баланс пополнен', item removed, balance 999000->999043, inv total 137->94. Single withdraw => toast 'Заявка на вывод 1 предм. создана', item removed, total ->50, balance unchanged, withdrawn stats incremented. Sell-all => toast 'Продано 3 предм.', empty state shown, total 0,00, balance 999137,00, button disabled when empty. Main page chip refreshed correctly after operations (Инвентарь · 1 / 50,00). Mobile 390px layout OK.

issues: On first paint after login the chip can briefly render 'Инвентарь · 0  0,00' before useSession refetches the authenticated user's data (observed once in 2 runs, self-corrects <500ms). Optional: hide/skeleton the chip until user data is loaded.

critical_code_review_comments: take_skins() silently ignores unknown/duplicate uids (POST /api/skins/sell with a bogus uid returns 200 and unchanged user). No double-credit bug found, but returning 404/400 for unknown uids would be clearer.
Overlay action buttons remain in the accessibility/tab order while hidden (opacity:0 only). Consider inert/aria-hidden or tabIndex=-1 on non-active .inv-actions.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/setup_test_user.py (user discord_test_1, balance 999000, 3 skins 43/44/50 = 137). Test consumed the skins (sold/withdrawn) - re-run the script before further UI tests.
test_credentials: JWT for session_id discord_test_1 minted with backend JWT_SECRET, injected as localStorage 'bloxgrade_token'
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_inventory_value.py auto-reseeds the test user before every test (autouse fixture), so it is safe to re-run. Frontend login = localStorage.setItem('bloxgrade_token', <jwt>) then reload. Overlay visibility must be asserted via computed opacity/pointer-events - Playwright is_visible() returns True for the opacity:0 overlay.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found for this iteration's scope.
